description: This PHP file defines a controller class for the OpenCart admin marketplace module. It manages marketplace listing, details, comments, downloading, purchasing, and extension management functionalities within the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Marketplace
classes.description: Controller class for handling marketplace interactions such as listing, details, comments, downloads, and extension operations within the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to load the marketplace page with filters, categories, licenses, sorts, and the list of extensions.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list view of marketplace extensions by delegating to getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and prepares a list of marketplace extensions from the external API, handles pagination, and returns the rendered view.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Fetches detailed information of a specific extension from the external API and displays it.

methods.name: extension
methods.description: Handles downloading and managing extension files, including install, uninstall, and delete actions.

methods.name: purchase
methods.description: Processes the purchase of an extension by interacting with external API and updating session data accordingly.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Handles downloading of extension files, saving them locally, and registering installation info.

methods.name: addComment
methods.description: Submits a comment to an extension, sending it via API.

methods.name: comment
methods.description: Retrieves comments for an extension and displays them.

methods.name: reply
methods.description: Retrieves reply comments for a specific comment and displays them.
